figures.captionSource: Local transport and full marginal compensation (schematic). A layer with thickness and mass of order \(O(\varepsilon)\), transported over distances of order \(O(\varepsilon)\), incurs second-order cost. The remaining nonnegative plan must cancel the local plan's coordinate CDF discrepancies. Their integrated absolute values give the compensation lower bound, with leading coefficients \(\|j_i\|_1\); a zero flux requires no corresponding leading-order compensation. The shaded discrepancy illustrates this mechanism.

Corner demand and return capacity, illustrated on \(I=I_3=[0,2]\) for \(\beta=7/4\), \(v=15/4\), \(\delta=0.35\). The blue region \(E_\delta\) stays away from the diagonal and has demand at least a positive multiple of \(\delta^2\). Return sources lie in the hatched triangles, which may extend beyond \(\Omega\); their area and squared displacement are both \(O(\delta^2)\), giving capacity \(O(\delta^4)\). The bounds shown, with \(\lambda=\min f\), \(\Lambda=\max f\), and \(\Delta=\xi_+-\xi_-\), violate \(M_\delta\le N_1+N_2\) for sufficiently small positive \(\delta\).

Proved risk envelopes for the independent uniform model with \(\beta=1\), \(p=1/2\), and \(\gamma=(1,1,2)\). Explicit mixtures attain the lower envelope; the upper envelope follows from midpoint potentials and the efficiency bound. The inset shows the exact initial interval \([0,1/96]\) in green. The dashed line extrapolates its slope to \(J=5/32\), whereas the critical budget lies in \([13/64,29/96]\). Both plotted envelopes are piecewise linear analytical formulas.

An optimal allocation of normal displacement on the tail
surface \(D\), at the equal-cost boundary, for
\(\vartheta=0\) (U, top) and \(\vartheta=1/4\) (D, bottom).

TeX line wrapping, layout commands, font styling, and text accents are converted to equivalent web markup.

Original theorem numbers, proof endings, result-part numbering, bibliography order, citation targets, and complete figure captions are retained.
Aliases on one original target share one web anchor; references to omitted appendices point to their exact pinned TeX source line.
The four original PNG siblings of the PDF figures are referenced at local asset paths, with their original Git blob identities recorded.
The public page title differs from the original paper title, which is recorded separately as sourceTitle.
